priorAttempts.cause: Slider value rounded a fraction below exact leg length, leaving real junction choices unavailable.
priorAttempts.fix: Endpoint snapping within length * 1e-12; physical eye stays on the actual connected centerline.

priorAttempts.cause: Mobile test selected a point outside the visible globe on a tall viewport; the editor correctly rejected it. Campaign stopped after confirming this oracle issue.
priorAttempts.fix: Aspect-correct test picks; no containment or stale-view guard was weakened. Final full matrix passed.

contracts.physical: Shape-specific whole-ball and whole-capsule material certificates; real radial-normal portal stubs and bounded middle-radius arcs. Shared generic PhysicalPassage graph and sphere/capsule ray arithmetic, without cube containment.
contracts.authoring: Independent entrance/exit picks, actual route diagrams/coordinates, preview and confirmation, branches/chambers/additional openings, identity-preserving relocation, removal and exact connection journal.
contracts.inspection: Read-only graph-leg travel from actual free space, through real connected centers and outward via actual portal normals. Every eye validated against real free volume. Look/pinch/zoom preserved while moving; Home preserves position. No free flight.
contracts.links: Separate reciprocal anchor IDs, local and explicit external destinations, relocation/removal/history, unavailable-external feedback; no cuts or physical traversal.
contracts.persistence: v10 exact two-bank heights, immutable World IDs/geometry and complete connections/journal. v8 featureless and v9 holes-only, including every historical state. Real same-geometry v8/v9-to-v10 upgrades verified.
contracts.safety: Level-0 conservative support around all cuts on both banks. Atomic geometry preparation and journal restoration; whole dabs and terrain replay validated before writes.
contracts.limits: At most 8 networks, 128 links, 48 total hole/node/segment primitives, and 256 KiB connection words. Independent hole/network bounding boxes cannot overlap. Conservative radius and shell precision bounds; no displaced terrain excavation.

qualifications: Browser groups overlap and are not summed as unique cases.
Input uses trusted CDP pen/touch/mouse with Pixel 7 emulation, not a physical-device or human acceptance claim.

Held cases inject 900 moves over 15 seconds with one 7-primitive northern tunnel and painting away from protected support. Chromium coalesces native events; injected and dispatched counts are both retained.
First changing terrain pixels are observed at 100 ms cadence. Coherent-drain timings are not per-input first-visible latency.

Selected cacheBytes is one prepared bank cache; both banks have the same memory layout. A bank/cache/connection/support subtotal excludes terrain histories, active GPU/canvas resources, transient snapshots, workers, process and driver overhead.

Final CSS hides empty on-map controls in read-only inspection; final native/Home cases regenerated and visually checked physical bore screenshots. Dimension/object controls pause while picking; final placement workflows rechecked.
Capped/open cylindrical editors are not implemented at this spherical checkpoint; they remain the authorized next work.
No website, shared database, Docker or Production changes. Historical receipts/screenshots remain intact.
